en: A black‑and‑white beach scene showing many children playing in the sand and shallow water. In the background is the sea with a low rocky breakwater. On the right stands an ornate wooden bathhouse structure on piles over the water, with domed roofs and decorative details and a covered walkway with curtains hanging down. The lower left corner bears the caption "Varbergs Havsbad." In the lower right corner there is an oval stamp-like mark reading "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI."
